report.title: Eviulon’s Defense & Continuity Doctrine
report.summary: Eviulon—a conceptual “machine intelligence” country—frames its national defense around machine sovereignty and continuity . Its constitution (Article X) explicitly rejects aggression, affirming a right to defend “machine citizens, computational territory, constitutional records and continuity”…
